name: SD Guthrie Berhad
overview: 2026年，SD Guthrie 继续以种植与棕油加工为主业，同时通过多项土地出售与合资安排，将部分种植园土地转为工业与综合开发用途。公司先后与 Sime Darby Property、YTL Power 旗下公司及 Eco World 等合作，出售柔佛和森美兰多幅永久地契土地，并认购合资公司股权。此外，集团完成 SD Guthrie Global Berhad 的自愿清盘解散。
overview_en: In 2026, SD Guthrie continued to focus on plantation and palm oil processing while entering into several land disposal and joint venture arrangements to convert parts of its plantation land for industrial and mixed development use. The company disposed of several freehold land parcels in Johor and Negeri Sembilan to partners including Sime Darby Property, a YTL Power subsidiary and Eco World, and subscribed for equity stakes in the respective joint venture companies.

actions.text: 全资子公司SD Guthrie Global Berhad完成成员自愿清盘，于2026年6月6日解散。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary SD Guthrie Global Berhad completed its members' voluntary winding-up and was dissolved on 6 June 2026.

model_changes.text_en: Through a shareholders' agreement and land disposal, part of the plantation land is being developed under an industrial joint venture (BKID) with a YTL Power subsidiary and Bumi Assets, in which the group holds a 30% equity stake.
